classification: The 24-strength family comes from Peterson and Seligman's 2004 classification. Citadel's wording and ranking procedure are original and experimental.

items.text: I find useful possibilities that other people overlook.
I pursue questions even when there is no immediate payoff.
I revise my view when the evidence changes.
I enjoy building a body of knowledge step by step.
People seek me out when a situation needs a wider perspective.
I act on a sound conviction even when it brings social risk.
I keep meaningful work moving after the novelty wears off.
My public account of myself matches what I do in private.
I bring usable energy to work that matters.
I make time for mutual closeness, not just contact.
I help in concrete ways without keeping a private ledger.
I notice what people are feeling and adjust without losing myself.
I do my share and help the group hold together.
I apply the same standard even when I personally prefer one side.
I can coordinate people around a shared direction without needing all the credit.
I can release a grievance without pretending the harm was acceptable.
I let good work speak before I reach for attention.
I pause long enough to see the likely cost of an impulse.
I can steer my attention, emotion, or habit when it pulls against my intention.
Beauty or excellent craft can stop me and deepen my attention.
I regularly recognize benefits I did not create alone.
I can imagine a better outcome and take a real step toward it.
I use play or wit to make difficulty more workable.
I orient my choices around a larger meaning or sacred frame.
